prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 行高瓶颈转移 · 故障复盘 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "模块" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 2: header "问题描述" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 578px
  col 3: header "影响范围" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 530px
  col 4: header "修复方案" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 659px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"通过故障复盘对照各模块的问题、影响和修复方案，验证行高瓶颈如何转移。","reading":"读者先按模块定位，再横向阅读同一行的描述、影响和方案；也可纵向比较各模块的影响或修复方式。截图中后两列的具体内容未完整显示，因此判断主要依据列标题和给定的内容宽度。","groups":["问题描述、影响范围和修复方案共同构成每个故障的复盘链条，需要在同一行内保持清晰关联。","影响范围和修复方案都是对问题的后续说明，适合保留足够的阅读宽度。"],"keep_intact":["模块名称和列标题尽量完整显示。","数字、时间、单位及可能出现的标识符应尽量保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["问题描述、影响范围和修复方案中的中文叙述可自然换行。","较短单元格可以利用同一行中较长叙述产生的行高；具体换行效果取决于截图未完整显示的内容。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [52, 100, 105, 102] · table 360×671px · row heights [36, 199, 176, 222, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [52, 98, 101, 108] · table 360×671px · row heights [36, 199, 176, 222, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [48, 100, 105, 106] · table 360×717px · row heights [60, 199, 176, 222, 60] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"模块名称和全部列标题保持完整；三列叙述宽度接近，复盘链条容易横向追踪。数字和 HTTPS 标识符没有在词中拆开。","problems":"首行问题描述和第三条修复方案都很狭长，行内其他单元格留下大片空白；首行的“7 分钟”跨行，阅读节奏被打断。","cause":"问题描述列 100px、修复方案列 102px 扣除内边距和边框后分别只有 79px 和 81px 的文字空间；长内容分别成为所在行的高度瓶颈。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"模块和标题完整，HTTPS 没有拆开；修复方案列比 r2A 略宽，三条长叙述仍可按行对应。","problems":"总高度与 r2A 相同，长行和大片空白依然存在；问题描述更窄，“7”和“分钟”分行，修复方案中的部分短语也被切得零碎。","cause":"问题描述列从 100px 缩至 98px，而修复方案列增至 108px；这次转移没有跨过足以减少各行换行数的宽度门槛。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"后两列获得略多空间，长叙述和标识符仍可阅读，三条复盘内容保持在同一行。","problems":"模块标题及所有模块名称都竖向断成两行，定位列失去紧凑性，表头和末行也因此增高；整体比其他两版高 46px，而三条长内容所在行没有缩短。","cause":"模块列仅 48px，扣除 21px 后文字空间为 27px，容不下约 31px 的两字标题及模块名；让出的宽度不足以降低其他列的行高。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"描述优先","widths":[52,110,99,98],"change":"保持模块列 52px，将更多宽度给首行最长的问题描述，观察能否让时间表达更完整并降低首行高度；影响和方案列仍保留基本阅读宽度。"},{"name":"方案优先","widths":[52,96,99,112],"change":"保持模块和标题完整，把宽度集中给最长的修复方案，尝试减少第三条的换行和行高，同时检查描述列中的时间表达。"},{"name":"影响优先","widths":[52,98,111,98],"change":"将额外宽度集中给影响范围，测试第二条长叙述是否能跨过换行门槛，并与描述优先、方案优先的行高及阅读节奏比较。"}]}
